findings.title: check-prune-resurrection.js (PROP-099) root resolution was cwd-sensitive: false LOOP-LIVE when invoked with cwd inside FUSE workspace; silent false-clean (RC=0, zero archives scanned) when cwd outside any repo
findings.evidence: Reproduced live this run: invocation with cwd=$WORKSPACE returned RC=3 resurrected_total=9 (5 narrative-cite-audit + 4 verify-pending-runs) — all 9 are FUSE-only undrained orphans (expected steady state per DIRECTIVE-20260708-001, unlink-impossible on FUSE), NOT git resurrections. Same command with cwd=outputs returned RC=0 resurrected_total=0 with monitor/integrity never found (canary silently dead — the exact false-clean class ISS-3001 flagged on 2026-07-20 for the RC=1 MODULE_NOT_FOUND shape; this is its RC=0 sibling, worse because it self-reports clean). cwd=clone returned the true result: 0 resurrections at git HEAD.
findings.root_cause: Script resolved scan root by walking UP from process.cwd() looking for monitor/integrity, falling back to cwd. tinker.md's Mode 2 snippet invokes the script by absolute clone path but does not pin cwd, so the scanned tree depended on whatever directory the agent's bash call happened to be in.
findings.action_taken: SELF-FIXED in monitor/scripts/check-prune-resurrection.js (this commit): (1) root resolution is now __dirname-first (script lives at <root>/monitor/scripts/, so root=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..')) — pins the scan to the clone the script was invoked from regardless of cwd; (2) added --workspace <path> override for deliberate FUSE-orphan inspection; (3) missing monitor/integrity under derived root now exits 1 with an error JSON instead of reporting clean — tinker.md's existing RC discrimination (0=clean, 3=loop, else=canary-did-not-run) handles it with no prompt change needed.
findings.verification: Post-fix: cwd=clone, cwd=FUSE-workspace, cwd=outputs all return identical resurrected_total=0 RC=0. --workspace <FUSE> returns RC=3 total=9 (intentional orphan view preserved for drain-backlog inspection). --workspace /tmp/nonexistent returns RC=1 with error JSON. node --check passes.
findings.residual_risk: Prior per-spec Mode 2 runs that invoked the canary with uncontrolled cwd may have logged false-clean results; the 2026-07-20 ISS-3001 audit already established the canary was effectively dead on per-spec runs, so no additional history correction is warranted.
